notes:
What's new

- Updates install reliably now: the updater helper runs from a temporary copy, so Windows no longer blocks the installer while it tries to replace WinPreview itself.
- The helper also starts before the single-instance check, so a running WinPreview can no longer swallow a Restart.
- The update notification stays above other windows instead of hiding behind your browser.
- Release notes scroll, the update log is capped, and update settings (check, background download, install when I exit) are in Settings.
changelog: WinPreview 1.3.8 - install handoff fix: the update helper is copied to %TEMP% before running (Inno aborted when WinPreview.exe held the install directory), the helper and self-test run before the single-instance guard, and the update pill is topmost.
